subject: Mathematics
slo: Read and write numbers up to 1,000,000 in symbols and words
prompt_sw: Andika nambari tano unazoziona nyumbani, kwa mfano bei za bidhaa, kisha zisome kwa maneno.
prompt_en: Write down five numbers you can see at home, such as product prices, then read them out in words.
activity_sw: Kusanya risiti tatu za dukani. Msomeshe mtoto kila jumla kwa maneno, kisha muulize aipange kutoka ndogo hadi kubwa.
activity_en: Collect three shop receipts. Have the child read each total in words, then order them from smallest to largest.

subject: Mathematics
slo: Estimate and measure capacity in litres and millilitres
prompt_sw: Kadiria kiasi cha maji kinachotoshea kwenye vyombo vitatu vya nyumbani, kisha pima.
prompt_en: Estimate how much water fits in three household containers, then measure to check.
activity_sw: Tumia chupa ya lita moja kujaza sufuria, ndoo na kikombe. Andika makadirio kabla ya kupima.
activity_en: Use a one-litre bottle to fill a pot, a bucket and a cup. Write the estimate before measuring.

subject: Science & Technology
slo: Separate a mixture of solids and liquids using simple methods
prompt_sw: Tenganisha mchanga na maji kwa kutumia kitambaa safi, kisha eleza kilichotokea.
prompt_en: Separate sand from water using a clean cloth, then explain what happened.
activity_sw: Changanya mchanga kidogo na maji kwenye chupa. Chuja kupitia kitambaa na mjadili kwa nini mchanga unabaki juu.
activity_en: Mix a little sand into water in a bottle. Filter it through cloth and discuss why the sand stays behind.

subject: Science & Technology
slo: Describe how plants make their own food
prompt_sw: Eleza jinsi jua linavyosaidia mmea kutengeneza chakula chake.
prompt_en: Explain how sunlight helps a plant make its own food.
activity_sw: Weka mmea mmoja kwenye jua na mwingine gizani kwa siku tano. Linganisheni rangi ya majani.
activity_en: Put one plant in sunlight and another in the dark for five days. Compare the colour of the leaves.
diy_materials: Mimea miwili kwenye vyungu (Two potted plants)

subject: Kiswahili
slo: Kusoma kifungu na kujibu maswali ya ufahamu
prompt_sw: Soma kifungu kifupi cha hadithi kisha jibu maswali matatu kwa sentensi kamili.
prompt_en: Read a short story passage, then answer three questions in full sentences.
activity_sw: Msomee mtoto habari moja kutoka gazetini, kisha muulize maswali matatu: nani, wapi, na kwa nini.
activity_en: Read one newspaper story to the child, then ask three questions: who, where, and why.

subject: English
slo: Read a short text aloud with correct pronunciation and retell it
prompt_sw: Soma kifungu kwa sauti, kisha kisimulie kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.
prompt_en: Read a passage aloud, then retell it in your own words.
activity_sw: Someni pamoja dakika kumi kila jioni. Baada ya kusoma, mtoto asimulie hadithi bila kuangalia kitabu.
activity_en: Read together for ten minutes each evening. Afterwards the child retells the story without looking at the book.

subject: Social Studies
slo: Describe trading activities in the local community
prompt_sw: Taja kazi tano unazoziona sokoni na ueleze jinsi zinavyotegemeana.
prompt_en: Name five jobs you see at the market and explain how they depend on each other.
activity_sw: Tembeeni sokoni pamoja. Mtoto aandike kazi tano na aeleze nani anamnunulia nani.
activity_en: Walk to the market together. The child lists five jobs and explains who buys from whom.

subject: Mathematics
slo: Add and subtract fractions with different denominators
prompt_sw: Gawanya chapati au mkate katika sehemu sawa na ueleze kila sehemu ni sehemu ngapi ya nzima.
prompt_en: Divide a chapati or loaf into equal parts and state what fraction each part is of the whole.
activity_sw: Wakati wa chakula, mtoto agawe chapati kwa watu watatu kisha aandike sehemu kila mmoja anapata.
activity_en: At mealtime, have the child share a chapati between three people and write the fraction each receives.

subject: Science & Technology
slo: Demonstrate simple methods of making water safe for drinking
prompt_sw: Onyesha njia mbili za kufanya maji kuwa salama kwa kunywa nyumbani.
prompt_en: Demonstrate two ways of making water safe to drink at home.
activity_sw: Tengenezeni kichujio kwa chupa, mkaa, mchanga na kokoto. Jadilini kwa nini kuchemsha bado ni muhimu.
activity_en: Build a filter from a bottle, charcoal, sand and gravel. Discuss why boiling is still necessary afterwards.

subject: Creative Arts
slo: Create a functional item from reclaimed materials
prompt_sw: Tengeneza kitu kimoja cha matumizi kwa kutumia vifaa vilivyotupwa.
prompt_en: Make one useful item entirely from discarded materials.
activity_sw: Kusanyeni chupa na makopo, kisha mtoto atengeneze chombo cha kuwekea kalamu na aeleze hatua alizofuata.
activity_en: Collect bottles and tins, then have the child build a pen holder and explain the steps they followed.

subject: Mathematics
slo: Form and solve linear equations from real-life situations
prompt_sw: Tunga mlingano kutokana na bei ya bidhaa dukani kisha uutatue.
prompt_en: Form an equation from a shop price situation, then solve it.
activity_sw: Mpe mtoto bajeti ya shilingi mia tano. Aandike mlingano wa kupata idadi ya bidhaa anazoweza kununua.
activity_en: Give the child a five-hundred shilling budget. Have them write an equation for how many items they can buy.
diy_materials: Bei halisi za dukani (Real shop prices)

subject: Social Studies
slo: Explain the functions of county government
prompt_sw: Eleza kazi tatu za serikali ya kaunti na jinsi zinavyoathiri familia yenu.
prompt_en: Explain three functions of county government and how each affects your family.
activity_sw: Jadilini huduma moja ya kaunti mnayoitumia, kwa mfano maji au soko, na mtoto aeleze inavyosimamiwa.
activity_en: Discuss one county service your family uses, such as water or the market, and have the child explain how it is run.
